about.title: FocusPanda
about.subtitle: Your Self-Discipline Partner
about.intro: FocusPanda is a unique app designed to help you build strong habits and improve focus through daily challenges and personal discipline.
about.section1_text: Focus training is the practice of strengthening your ability to stay on track and achieve personal goals through daily actions.
about.section3_text: We aim to help you build strong focus and personal discipline by providing tools that support your daily progress.

taskDescription.books_description: Build a daily reading habit to boost your intelligence, focus, and inner balance.
taskDescription.water_description: Stay hydrated and support your health and well-being by drinking 2 liters of water every day.
taskDescription.meditate_description: Daily meditation helps lower stress, sharpen your focus, and strengthen your inner peace.
taskDescription.wake_7am_description: Waking up early sets a productive tone, gives you more energy, and time for yourself.
taskDescription.media_description: Refusing social media improves focus, boosts productivity, frees time, and reduces stress.
taskDescription.evening_run_description: An evening run helps you unwind, sleep better, and strengthen your heart and lungs.
taskDescription.no_sugar_description: Cutting out sugar helps with weight loss, better skin, and stable energy levels.
taskDescription.alcohol_description: Avoiding alcohol improves your liver health, mental clarity, sleep, and self-discipline.
taskDescription.sleep_description: Going to bed by 10 PM helps your body recover, strengthens immunity, and improves focus.

DescriptionBtn.banner: Choose a goal and follow it for 21 days
